research_scope: Original SPDZCoder release stage-2 (without-logged-repair) versus stage-3 historical evaluator flags; observational paired identity comparison, not fresh original generation
provenance: Saved author evaluation logs and task-id positions verified against the official identity ledger. No MPC or LLM execution in the stage-audit job. Exact source code of each candidate is not re-evaluated here; separately accepted B2b does rerun final stage only.
interpretation_limits: Not a fresh controlled no-repair ablation or causal repair efficacy estimate. Saved stage2/3 candidate strings and token metadata may differ without complete intermediate repair transcripts. Paper's no-repair values verified by recalculation of author-saved flags.
